chunks: "Whoever trims his nails on Friday, his fingertips will not become disheveled."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the merit of trimming one's nails on Friday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام encourages personal cleanliness on Friday. It presents trimming the nails on Jumu'ah as a praiseworthy act associated with neatness and good outward condition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.308 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever trims their nails on Jumu’ah will not have disheveled fingertips."
